angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 702,894 km at 708.45 pc = 0.01 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 1.4115 +/- 0.0151 mas (same row, RUWE 1.02): 708.45 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.01034 solar radii from TICv8, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of Kepler-17 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract): 702,894 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.04 solar masses from TICv8, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of Kepler-17 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5781 +/- 85 K from TICv8, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of Kepler-17 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: TICv8, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of Kepler-17 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/kepler-17.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.446, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Kepler-17 (pscomppars): spectral type G2 V, from Bonomo et al. 2011 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2011arXiv1110.5462B/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, Kepler-17: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Kepler-17 (pscomppars): [M/H] 0.26 dex, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Kepler-17 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.01164, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Kepler-17 (pscomppars): age 1.8 Gyr, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Kepler-17 (pscomppars): rotation period 12.01 d, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Kepler-17 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 6 km/s, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
